description: READ BACK a composition as JSON — the edit itself: tracks, clips, card HTML, reframe segments, captions, markers, format. This is what create_render encodes, so it is also what you hand to validate_composition (which needs a full inline composition body), what you diff after an edit, and what you archive/share so someone else can re-render the SAME video. Read-only and free. Authoring stays op-based (apply_composition) — do not round-trip this object back as a write. A composition too large to fit one MCP result degrades to a STRUCTURAL SUMMARY (every track and clip still listed; card html and caption words elided as lengths) with a header saying so — read it over REST if you need the verbatim body. Defaults to the project's ACTIVE composition; pass `compositionId` to read a specific one (the same id apply_composition takes as `composition_id`, and preview_frame / create_render take as compositionId) so an A/B variant can be read back, not just written. The result includes the exact HTTP etag string; copy it to apply_composition.body.if_match (the numeric revision is not an ETag). Pass includeDependencies="true" on a v1 guarded endpoint to read composition_id, revision and dependency tokens. With componentExecutionVersions=["3","4"], this envelope also returns expectedBrandIdentity from the persisted project authority; carry it unchanged into the matching negotiated write. Preserve those observed tokens when authoring; never refresh the basis to hide a conflict. BOTH shapes carry `needsUpgrade` when clips are stored in a retired form (unpinned or TSX component placements, removed primitives): each entry names the clipId, the kind and, when one exists, the native successor pin — move those with repin_component and rebuild the rest with create_component; such a composition will not save or render as-is. Absent when nothing needs upgrading.

componentExecutionVersions.description: The component execution versions this reader accepts, one parameter per version: 3, or 3 and 4 (native placements). Absent readers accept only the historical protocol.

compositionId.description: Read a SPECIFIC composition instead of the project's active one. Omit it and the active composition is returned. Pairs with `composition_id` on the apply op: an edit you can make to a second composition is one you can read back.

includeDependencies.description: Return the immutable composition identity, project revision and shared v1 dependency expectations alongside the composition.

name: get_composition
title: Get Composition
